name: Garrett
bio:
Originally from Idaho, Garrett has spent the past 15 years in Utah and now calls Cache Valley home, although he still claims dual Idaho/Utah citizenship (we've told him that's not a thing, but he's still going with it). His interest in entrepreneurship started at an early age while helping and watching his parents run several small businesses (shout out to Kite Automotive & Outback Products). They taught him the value of hard work, something he still carries with him today. That early exposure to business ownership eventually led to a goal of starting a business of his own.
While attending Utah State University, Garrett studied entrepreneurship and marketing and started freelancing in website design and digital marketing. That eventually turned into Kite Media. After several years of running things on his own, he began bringing others onboard to help with the growing workload. The business has changed quite a bit since then, moving from his spare bedroom, to his kitchen table, to a small office in Providence, and eventually to the current spot on Main Street.
Today, Garrett wears a few different hats at KM but spends most of his time in business development, stocking the drink cooler, and managing the endless responsibilities that come with owning a small business.
Outside of work, he's a fan of the outdoors, especially the mountains and lakes, and takes any chance he can get to visit the beach. On an ideal day, he's enjoying all three at Bear Lake. He's obsessed with cars, loves technology, could eat pizza for every meal, drinks obscene amounts of Diet Coke with lime, and enjoys playing and watching a variety of sports. Above all, he loves spending time with his family.
Garrett enjoys digital marketing because it combines creativity, strategy, and design while giving him the opportunity to help other small businesses grow.

name: Adam
bio:
Adam is one of Kite Media's longest-tenured team members, joining the team in 2016 after moving from his hometown of Kaysville, Utah to attend Utah State University. He started at KM as a part-time college student working on search engine optimization and has since worked his way into managing our entire website design service. Not a bad upgrade from a part-time college job.
Today, Adam oversees our website projects from start to finish, helping make sure each site looks awesome, works great, and does what it's supposed to do. He enjoys web design because it combines two of his interests: creativity and technology. He also has a knack for figuring out how things work, which comes in handy when a website inevitably decides to do something it shouldn't.
Outside of work, Adam spends most of his time with his wife and kids. He's a big Utah football and Utah Jazz fan, enjoys home improvement shows (and occasionally getting ideas from them that he implements at his own house), and is always up for some good Mexican food. He also plays guitar and enjoys finding time to pick it up whenever life with kids allows.
After nearly a decade at Kite Media, Adam has seen just about every stage of the company and has been a big part of its growth along the way. He enjoys the work because every website brings a new combination of creative challenges, technical problems to solve, and opportunities to help a business look great online.

name: Kym
bio:
Kym joined the Kite Media team in 2017 after studying technical communication and marketing at Utah State University, where she developed a broad range of digital marketing skills. Over the years, she's become our resident search engine optimization expert and one of the people we rely on to keep up with the constantly changing world of SEO. Google likes to change things just often enough to keep everyone on their toes, so having Kym around is pretty helpful.
In addition to SEO, Kym has a sharp eye for detail and plays a big role in keeping the quality of our work where it needs to be. She reviews and edits just about everything we do, catches the things the rest of us miss, and generally helps keep us from embarrassing ourselves on the internet.
One of her favorite things about digital marketing is getting to use such a broad skillset to help businesses accomplish their goals. Every business is a little different, so she enjoys figuring out what will work best for each client and finding ways to help them succeed.
Outside of work, Kym spends her time with her family and her sweet kids. She enjoys reading, playing board games, and pretty much anything involving ice cream - although she admits she probably eats a little too much of it. But we're not here to judge.
After so many years at Kite Media, Kym has become an important part of keeping both our clients and our team moving in the right direction. She enjoys digital marketing because it gives her the opportunity to combine strategy, creativity, and attention to detail while helping small businesses grow.

name: Spencer
bio:
Spencer grew up in the city of dreams, aka Lindon, Utah, and eventually made his way to Utah State University, where he graduated with a degree in communication studies. At USU, he became obsessed with all things communication. His experience in digital marketing has only added to that obsession and helped him develop a knack for building strong relationships with just about anyone. Speaking of that, he met his wife in college and sealed the deal on that relationship like a champ.
Spencer joined Kite Media in 2019 and has worn just about every hat on the team since then. Today, he manages our SEO and PPC services while also working directly with clients to help improve their marketing. He's particularly good at making complicated marketing stuff feel a little less complicated, which is helpful when Google decides to change something for the 58th time.
More than anything, Spencer enjoys working with people. He strives to be a friend to everyone he meets and is passionate about serving others, whether that's helping a client solve a problem, making a coworker laugh, or welcoming a new team member with one of his infamous get-to-know-you questions. He's pretty good at breaking the ice in just about any situation.
Outside of work, Spencer spends most of his time with his wife and kids. He's a die-hard Dodgers and Utah Jazz fan, enjoys playing rec softball, pickup basketball, and has somehow convinced himself that running is a fun way to spend the early morning hours between 5 AM and 7 AM. Above all, Spencer loves being around people and making them laugh and smile.
Spencer enjoys digital marketing because it gives him the opportunity to combine his love of communication with his desire to help people. Whether he's working with a client, helping a teammate, or just making someone laugh, he believes the best work starts with a good relationship.

name: Natalie
role: Social Media Specialist, Digital Marketing Specialist
bio:
Natalie grew up in Farmington, Utah, but she's always had an itch to experience new places. She earned her associate's degree from BYU-Hawaii before transferring to Utah State University, where she graduated with a degree in public relations and marketing. These days, she lives in St. George, Utah, proving that the urge to explore new places never really went away.
At Kite Media, Natalie enjoys the variety that comes with digital marketing and the opportunity to tackle new challenges. She likes figuring things out, getting creative, and finding effective ways to solve whatever new problem happens to land on her desk. No two days are exactly the same, which is probably a good thing for someone who likes trying new things.
Outside of work, Natalie spends most of her time with her husband and kids. She's a big fan of Bear Lake and Hawaii, and will take just about any excuse to visit either one. She also loves a good book, salt and vinegar chips (and has been known to take down an entire bag in one sitting), and Coke. Lots of Coke. She also firmly believes there's nothing cuter than a baby in a Halloween costume, and she's probably right.
Natalie enjoys digital marketing because it gives her the chance to be creative, learn new things, and find solutions to challenges that help businesses succeed. Whether she's working through a new project or finding a better way to get something done, she enjoys the process of figuring it out and making things happen.

name: Megan
bio:
Megan was born in Logan, Utah, but grew up in Denver, Colorado. Eventually, she made her way back to Logan to attend Utah State University, where she graduated with a degree in marketing. While at USU, she met her husband, and the two decided Cache Valley was a pretty good place to call home.
At Kite Media, Megan works with our clients on search engine optimization and social media advertising. She's always enjoyed both her creative side and analytical sides, which makes digital marketing a pretty good fit. She likes coming up with creative ideas and strategies, but she's also happy to dive into the numbers and figure out what is actually working. Basically, she gets to use both sides of her brain.
Megan enjoys the variety that comes with digital marketing and the challenge of figuring out what will help each client succeed. She especially likes being able to take something that can feel complicated and turn it into a strategy that makes sense and gets results.
When she's not working, Megan enjoys spending time with her husband and daughter, curling up with a good book, and binge-watching The Great British Baking Show. She also loves to travel and go on new adventures, so she's always happy to have an excuse to explore somewhere new. Although, after growing up in Colorado and returning to Cache Valley, apparently she has a soft spot for mountains.
Megan enjoys digital marketing because it combines creativity, strategy, and analytics in a way that keeps her learning and gives her the opportunity to help businesses grow.

name: Taylor
bio:
Taylor grew up in small-town Shelley, Idaho, before heading to Utah to attend Utah State University. Although he eventually finished his degree in business management through BYU-Idaho and now lives in Idaho Falls, he's still an Aggie at heart.
Taylor joined Kite Media in 2021 and supports our clients through onboarding, communication, and a variety of digital marketing efforts. He's a people person who genuinely enjoys getting to know others and building relationships that last beyond a business transaction. He also loves helping business owners grow and enjoys getting to watch that growth happen over time.
Outside of work, Taylor spends most of his time with his wife, kids, and dog, and he absolutely loves being a dad. According to his wife, he's also a little too obsessed with football and basketball. Taylor won't deny it. When he's not watching sports, he's usually playing them, coaching football, or trying to convince someone to join his fantasy football league. Every year, he's on the lookout for a few more people who think they can beat him.
Taylor enjoys digital marketing because it gives him the opportunity to work with people, solve problems, and play a part in helping businesses succeed. He especially enjoys seeing the long-term results of the relationships he builds with our clients and being able to celebrate their wins along the way.

name: Ashley
bio:
Ashley grew up in Eagle Mountain, Utah, before moving to Logan to attend Utah State University. She graduated with a degree in social media marketing and joined the Kite Media team shortly afterward.
Around the office, Ashley - or "A.B." as we call her - is our Swiss Army knife. She supports clients across a variety of digital marketing services, including search engine optimization, pay-per-click advertising, and social media advertising. She also manages Kite Media's social media profiles, so if you see something we posted that made you laugh, there's a good chance Ashley had something to do with it.
Ashley decided to pursue digital marketing because she loves creating things and seeing those things actually accomplish something. Whether it's a new campaign, a social post, or a strategy for helping a client grow, she enjoys the combination of creativity and results that comes with the job.
Outside of work, Ashley loves spending time with her husband and son, traveling to new places, and finding good memes. She's also always up for an excuse to explore somewhere she's never been, preferably with a good restaurant involved.
Ashley enjoys digital marketing because it gives her the freedom to be creative while still having a measurable impact. She likes being able to take an idea, turn it into something useful, and see how it helps a business move forward.

name: Josh
bio:
Josh grew up in Layton, Utah, and attended Utah Valley University, where he studied digital marketing. He's one of the few non-Aggies on the Kite Media team, but we don't hold that against him. At least not too much.
Josh has always been drawn to digital marketing because it's constantly changing. There's always something new to learn, test, or figure out, which keeps things interesting and gives him plenty of opportunities to keep growing. He joined the Kite Media team in 2022 and has spent his time helping our clients with their SEO, PPC and social media advertising needs.
Josh enjoys the problem-solving side of digital marketing and likes being able to help businesses improve their online presence. Whether he's working on search engine optimization, managing a campaign, or figuring out why Google decided to change something again, he enjoys the challenge of finding ways to make things work better.
When he's not working, Josh prefers to be outside fishing or camping. When he's forced to come indoors, you'll probably find him cheering on his favorite hockey team, the (not-so-successful) Philadelphia Flyers, or spending time with his wife and their boys.
Josh enjoys digital marketing because it combines constant learning with the opportunity to make a real difference for businesses. He likes being able to take what he learns, put it into practice, and help clients build a stronger presence online.

name: Bryson
bio:
Bryson joined the Kite Media team in 2022 and works as a search engine optimization and pay-per-click advertising specialist. He enjoys the strategy and problem-solving that comes with digital marketing, especially the SEO process and the opportunity to see how his work can make a real difference for our clients.
Outside of work, Bryson's favorite thing is spending time with his wife and kids. He's also a big sports fan, especially when it comes to basketball, although he's unfortunately reached the point where he no longer expects his favorite team, the Utah Jazz, to win when it counts. We can't blame him.
Bryson enjoys a good mix of getting outside and staying in. He loves spending time outdoors, but he's just as happy settling in for a good movie. One of his favorites is Nacho Libre, which tells you pretty much everything you need to know about his taste in movies. He also loves to laugh and enjoys working with others, making him a good fit for the team-oriented environment at Kite Media.
There are a few things Bryson will not compromise on, however. Pickles and olives are both firmly off the table. Literally. Don't put them on his food.
Bryson enjoys digital marketing because it gives him the opportunity to combine strategy, problem-solving, and measurable results while helping businesses grow. He especially enjoys seeing the work he puts into SEO and PPC translate into real improvements for our clients.

name: Sammie
bio:
Sammie is a Cache Valley native and Utah State University graduate, where she competed as a Division I athlete playing soccer for the Aggies. She studied marketing as an undergraduate and later earned her master's degree in business administration. So between the marketing degree, MBA, and years of competing at a high level, she's pretty well equipped to get things done.
Sammie joined Kite Media as an SEO and PPC specialist. She brings the same competitive mindset to digital marketing that she brought to the soccer field and is determined to use her skills to help our clients reach their goals and win. She's always looking for ways to improve, try something new, and find strategies that will help our clients move their businesses forward.
Outside of work, Sammie still enjoys watching and playing sports, so she hasn't completely left her competitive days behind. She also loves reading and finding new recipes to try.
Sammie enjoys digital marketing because it gives her the opportunity to combine strategy, creativity, and her competitive nature while helping businesses accomplish their goals. She loves being part of the process and seeing the work we do turn into real progress for our clients.

name: Nate
bio:
Nate grew up in Herriman, Utah, before moving to Logan to attend Utah State University, where he earned a degree in marketing. While studying, he discovered a particular interest in digital marketing and liked the idea of using data to help businesses make better decisions and grow. That interest eventually led him to Kite Media, where he joined the team in 2023 as an SEO specialist.
Nate enjoys the analytical side of digital marketing and the process of digging into the data to figure out what's working, what isn't, and what can be improved. He likes that there's always something new to learn and that the work can be measured to see how it's actually helping our clients.
Outside of work, Nate enjoys a pretty wide variety of things, including sports, music from the '60s through the '80s, film photography, and spending time with his wife and family. During the recent World Cup, Nate became our unofficial in-office soccer coach and spent plenty of time teaching the rest of us the ins and outs of the game. We still don't understand offsides, but let's be honest, no one does.
Nate enjoys digital marketing because it combines his interest in data with the opportunity to help businesses grow. He likes being able to dig into the numbers, find opportunities for improvement, and see how those changes translate into real results for our clients.

name: Krista
bio:
Krista is originally from California but grew up all around the Salt Lake Valley before eventually attending Utah Valley University, where she earned a degree in digital marketing. She joined Kite Media with a passion for the industry and a desire to use her skills to help small businesses reach their goals.
Krista loves digital marketing because it combines two things she enjoys: creativity and analytics. She likes being able to solve problems, dig into the data, and find strategies that can make a real difference for a business. There's something satisfying about taking a challenge, figuring out what needs to change, and seeing the results of that work.
At Kite Media, Krista enjoys getting to know our clients and finding ways to help them grow. She especially likes that digital marketing is always changing, which means there's always something new to learn and a new problem to solve.
Outside of work, Krista spends plenty of time with her husband and dog. She also describes herself as a grandma when it comes to her hobbies, which is probably accurate considering her love of crafting, quilting, reading, and drawing. She also enjoys getting outdoors and making memories with friends and family. We're not sure what qualifies as a "grandma hobby," but we're pretty sure she has the bases covered.
Krista enjoys digital marketing because it gives her the opportunity to combine creativity, strategy, and problem-solving while helping small businesses accomplish their goals. She loves being able to take what she knows and turn it into something that makes a real difference for the people and businesses she works with.
